questions.corrige_markdown:
Work inside the brackets first. Change the mixed numbers to improper fractions.

$2\dfrac12=\dfrac52$ and $1\dfrac15=\dfrac65$.

$\dfrac52-\dfrac65=\dfrac{25}{10}-\dfrac{12}{10}=\dfrac{13}{10}$.

Dividing by $\dfrac35$ means multiplying by $\dfrac53$:

$\dfrac{13}{10}\div\dfrac35=\dfrac{13}{10}\times\dfrac53=\dfrac{65}{30}=\dfrac{13}{6}$.

**Answer: $\dfrac{13}{6}=2\dfrac16$.**
